title: Enterprise Support: Export-to-outlaying conversion for missing-outlay recognition
content:
Enterprise Support — Export-to-outlaying conversion for missing-outlay recognition.

## Decision basis

For missing-outlay recognition: Multiply missing exported vCPU-hours by the effective cloud rate to obtain missing eligible eligible supported expenditure in USD expenditure.

## Hypothetical case

For missing-outlay recognition: A hypothetical missing export of 120 vCPU-hours at an effective cloud price of USD 0.40 per vCPU-hour yields USD 48 of eligible support expenditure.
